name: Tendoji Musubi
source: A 16-year-old girl who is seemingly perfect with her dashing good looks and excellent grades, Musubi is top of her class and serves as the student council president despite only being a first year in high school. However, deep down, she is just like any ordinary girl who constantly struggles with anxiety. She meets Haru and Rona at NANASUTA and gradually becomes comfortable with her true character.
